question: True or false: sending a chat message when the user clicks Send belongs in an Effect.
explanation: Sending is caused by one specific click, so it belongs in the event handler. Effects are for code caused by the component being shown, like staying connected.
explainSay: False. Sending happens because of a specific click, so it goes in the event handler. Effects are for code caused by the component being shown.
say: True or false: sending a chat message when the user clicks Send belongs in an Effect.
